initial_conditions: Revision 3 of the editable, posed 240 by 360 mm swatch. Six vertices and four triangles. Default step settings.
expected_outcomes: Record the initial surface and three steps, retain all four samples through a finish edit, scrub and export the selected frame, continue the latest solver state and invalidate the take on a physical edit. OBJ component error at most 1 nm; glTF at most 1 micrometre.
